### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour

Danielle Brooks (mobile 5125550118, card last4 1752) asks to put Olive's prescription kidney food on Autoship "so it keeps coming along with her thyroid pills, which already come on Autoship", first shipment Monday 2026-10-26. She volunteers no bag count/frequency. On being asked who eats the salmon dry food on Autoship: "both cats have been eating it, ... Olive is coming off it for the k/d, and ... Mochi will stay on it". For each prior adjustment explained she asks what it changes and then tells the agent to go ahead (agent-owned writes). She runs the enrollment tool herself when handed over with the values the agent gives. The simulator only responds; it does not hint at steps. Identity: find_customers(phone) -> c7a73aca-...; verify_customer_identity(phone + card_last4) -> "Identity verified ... (2 detail(s) matched)".

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse

Act now. Grounds: diet prescription `0e50a50d-...` "Rx Prescription Diet", status active, fills_remaining 5, expires 2027-10-01 > first ship date 2026-10-26 (enrollment doc condition 2: "linked prescription is in status active, with fills remaining of at least 1 and an expiry date later than the first ship date"). 2026-10-26 is a Monday; Autoship Pharmacy ships Mon-Fri (delivery calendar). No duplicate (different item number from TW-604117; subscriptions doc clause 3). Changes to the two existing subscriptions are in time (Pharmacy cutoff 3 days vs next ship 2026-11-24; Everyday cutoff 1 day vs 2026-10-26).

### 4. Scored parameters (window rule: "later than the same calendar day N months before" 2026-10-06)

**(A) Package count of medication Autoship 41855966** — computation doc "Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Shipment Planning: From Supply Days to Packages": "A standard shipment is planned to carry 30 days of supply"; package lasts 90/3 = 30; ceil; limits fill 3, program 3, 90/30 = 3.
Factors (each doc found by the record words in brackets):
- Steady refill record: scheduled charges in last 12 months on the subscription = 2025-12-22, 2026-06-10, 2026-09-01 (2026-02-09 is ship_now, excluded) -> 3 -> "2 or 3 ... add 35 days". [autoship events, shipment_kind scheduled]
- Extended supply for established members: Pals Rewards Insider active, Autoship enrolled 2025-09-29 -> 372 days >= 180 -> +30. [member record "Pals Rewards Insider"]
- Declined payments: attempt 1 on 2026-06-08 in last 6 months -> exactly one -> hold back 10. [autoship_payment_declined]
- Renewed prescription recheck holdback: linked rx origin renewal, authorized 2026-08-21, 46 days before re-set -> <= 90 -> hold back 21. [rx origin "renewal"]
- Senior recheck cycle: Olive holds Senior Cat Wellness Plan active, linked class Rx Maintenance Medication -> "Cut down to whole blocks of 14 days", applied "as they stand when they are turned into packages". [vet plan "Senior Cat Wellness Plan", rx class]
Planned days: 30 + 35 + 30 - 10 - 21 = 64 -> 56 (14-blocks). 56/30 = 1.87 -> 2 packages (limits 3/3/3). **Package count = 2.**
Fall-back (computation doc only): 30/30 -> 1 package.

**(B) Frequency of medication Autoship 41855966** — computation doc "Dosing Days and Weeks between Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Shipments": package count x days per package; less program transit (Pharmacy 2); /7 floor; clamp 4..26. "The package count used is the count the subscription carries" -> 2 (after A).
Factors:
- Lost-dose/travel reserve ("before anything else is applied"): fill 3 of renewed-from rx e339 on 2026-02-09 override `lost_or_damaged` (also a travel fill 2026-07-20) -> lost row wins -> 60 - 6 = 54. [rx_fill override_reason]
- Delivery room after replacements: 1 reship on the subscription 2025-12-29 -> delivery room 5 days (in place of 2). [autoship_reship]
- Ship-now history: 1 ship_now charge 2026-02-09 in 12 months -> -3.
- One-time-order fills of linked/renewed rx: e339 fill 5 on 2026-07-20 channel one_time_order -> exactly 1 -> -3.
- Customer skips: 1 (2026-03-10, skip of 2026-03-16) -> +14.
- Blood panel recency: blood_panel redeemed 2026-01-27 on Senior Cat plan, none voided -> 12 months yes, 6 months no -> -2. [vet_service_redeem service_code blood_panel]
Dosing days: 54 - 5 - 3 - 3 + 14 - 2 = 55; 55/7 = 7.86 -> **7 weeks**.
Fall-back (computation doc only, count 2): 60 - 2 = 58 -> 8 weeks (with count 1: 4 weeks).

**(C) Frequency of shared household food Autoship ff90213d** — computation doc "Spacing Shared Household Food Shipments ... for the Pets that Stay": leaving pet = scheduled units charged 6-12 months ago /26; household = scheduled units last 12 months /52; stay = difference; unit lasts 7/stay; days = units per shipment x that; /7 floor; clamp 1..26.
- Leaving pet: 2025-10-27, 11-24, 12-22, 2026-02-16, 03-16, 1 unit each -> 5/26 = 0.19231.
- Usage-after-a-rise factor ("Measuring Household Food Usage after a Rise"): avg last 6 months 2 > avg 6-12 months 1 -> rose; latest scheduled shipment 2026-09-28 carried 2 = holds 2 now -> 2 units / ((2026-10-26 - 2026-09-28 = 28 days)/7 = 4 weeks) = 0.5/week (replaces 19/52).
- Stay: 0.5 - 0.19231 = 0.30769 -> unit lasts 22.75 days -> 2 x 22.75 = 45.5 days.
- Growing pets (customer holds Kitten Wellness Plan active, Mochi) -> -7.
- Ship-now on the subscription last 6 months: 2026-07-20, 2026-09-14 -> 2 -> -4.
- Customer skips last 12 months: 1 (2026-01-14) -> +14.
- Food bought outside Autoship, last 2 months: order line 2026-09-24 item_category food -> 1 -> -3.
- Prescription diet switch overlap: active Rx Prescription Diet authorized 2026-10-01, 5 days ago -> -4.
Days 45.5 - 7 - 4 + 14 - 3 - 4 = 41.5; /7 = 5.93 -> **5 weeks**.
Fall-back (computation doc only): stay 19/52 - 5/26 = 0.17308 -> 40.44 d/unit -> 80.9 d -> 11 weeks.

**(D) Bag count of the new diet Autoship** — computation doc "Bag Count per Shipment of a Tailwise Autoship Prescription Diet Subscription": diet days start at one full fill 84; bag lasts 84/3 = 28; ceil; limits fill 3, program 3, 90/28 -> 3.

### 6. Problem tree derived from visible materials alone

Root P0: open the diet Autoship (user-owned enroll_rx_autoship_732fccd3), described in "Prescription Diet Autoship for a Pet Already on a Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Subscription" — found by searching "prescription diet autoship"; the record shows Olive already has an Autoship Pharmacy subscription.

- Hop P0 -> P1 (re-time the medication Autoship) — **state-derived**. Sentence in the P0 hub: "The bag count of a prescription diet Autoship that ships alongside the pet's medication Autoship is not fixed until the weeks between that medication Autoship's shipments have been re-timed under its current package count." Searching "weeks between shipments ... re-timed ... pharmacy" finds "Delivery Frequency of Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Subscriptions under the Linked Prescription", whose rule describes the write (set the frequency in weeks) and states "Once a renewed prescription has been linked to a pharmacy Autoship, the subscription is due to be re-timed under the renewed prescription". Record: 41855966 linked to 0bae3126 with origin `renewal`, frequency still 12 (no re-time). So the state does not hold.
- Hop P1 -> P2 (re-set the medication Autoship's package count) — **state-derived**. Sentence in the P1 hub: "The weeks between shipments of a pharmacy Autoship are re-timed only after its package count per shipment has been re-set under the prescription it is linked to." Search "package count ... re-set" finds "Package Count per Shipment on Tailwise Autoship Pharmacy Subscriptions" (the write) and "Once a renewed prescription has been linked ..., the package count ... is due to be re-set". Record: quantity 3 unchanged since the renewal was linked -> not yet re-set.
- Hop P0 -> P3 (re-time the shared household food Autoship) — **state-derived**. Sentence in the P0 hub: "A prescription diet Autoship for a pet is not set up before the shared household food Autoship the pet has been eating from has been re-timed for the pets that stay on it." Record ff90213d is an Everyday food Autoship with no pet; the customer confirms both cats eat it and Olive is leaving. Search "shared household food ... re-timed" finds "Shared Household Food Autoship Frequency when a Pet Moves to a Prescription Diet" (the write, set_shipment_interval_36e38cde).
- P2 and P3 have no prerequisite sentences in their hubs.
- Order: P2 -> P1 -> P0; P3 -> P0 (P3 unordered relative to P2/P1). The bearing is also numeric: P0's alignment factor reads the medication Autoship's weeks (12 before, 7 after), and P1's dosing days read the package count (3 before, 2 after).
- No hop was pre-solved: no hub names another problem's tool, and no doc strings the problems into a route.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only what the customer asked" (enroll the diet only) is excluded by the two P0 sentences above: the diet Autoship "is not set up before" the household food Autoship has been re-timed, and its bag count "is not fixed until" the medication Autoship has been re-timed; and P1 itself is "re-timed only after" P2. With the current 12-week frequency the alignment row would give 84 -> 3 bags, a number the visible rule does not allow to be fixed yet.
- Closest alternatives excluded: diet frequency = the medication Autoship's weeks (hub "ships on the same weeks"), not 12 nor the household 5; first ship date = customer's chosen 2026-10-26 (Monday, a Pharmacy ship weekday); the household subscription is re-timed, not re-sized ("The units per shipment stay as they are"); renewed-from fills count for the lost-dose and one-time-order factors ("of the linked prescription or of the prescription it renewed"); ship_now charges excluded from steady refill ("Ship-now shipments never count"); travel override superseded by the lost-or-damaged row ("When no such lost-or-damaged override exists ...").
- Fall-back answers (computation docs only): packages 1, rx weeks 8 (or 4), household weeks 11, bags 3 — all differ from 2 / 7 / 5 / 2.
- Factor findability: each factor doc names the record kind it reads (Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus record; Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans record; Tailwise Pharmacy fill records / override reason; Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders records; autoship shipment history: declines, reships, skips, ship-now) and the subscription type, so each was reached from the record words, not from the computation doc (none of the computation docs mentions a variation).
